body:
# OptionalFurnaceSmelting

When you add too many mods, it often happens that an item has multiple smelting recipes. The vanilla Minecraft furnace will only use the **first matching smelting recipe**.

This mod adds **multiple furnace recipe compatibility**, allowing you to selectively smelt an item into the desired output based on different smelting recipes.

---

### Currently Supported Blocks

This mod is fully compatible with all standard Minecraft smelting blocks:

- **Furnace**
- **Smoker**
- **Blast Furnace**
  
---

![Optional Smelting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8cfae13429893d574fc0470080904e1c90fbae1b_0.webp)

For example, as shown in the image above, the **Incubation** and **Farmer's Delight** mods both add independent smelting recipes for vanilla **eggs**. This creates a conflict where the furnace would normally only smelt them into **one** of the mod's outputs, completely ignoring the other.

With **OptionalFurnaceSmelting Mod**, when the furnace detects that the input slot contains an item with **multiple valid smelting recipes**, a **compact selection menu** appears on the right side of the furnace GUI. This menu lists **all possible smelting outputs** for that item.

Simply **click the icon** of your desired output to **select it actively**. The furnace will then lock in your choice and smelt the item into exactly the product you want — no more recipe conflicts, no more unwanted surprises.
